title: Heli Rescue update: One month and (Free) 80,000+ credits later, I finally have a Mission and Night Lighting
author: Huge_Veterinarian572
selftext:
what I’d call my dream project. I’m going to keep building, coding, and improving it until it’s exactly how I’ve imagined it.

The game now has nighttime lighting, aircraft flying through the sky, clouds, and **15 playable missions across Switzerland**. You’re not limited to Switzerland, though, you can also explore cities anywhere in the world. There’s a career mode too, where you receive assignments and take on different jobs.

Here’s some gameplay from one of the missions: **taking off from the base and flying into Zurich**, with a great view of the city lights along the way.
